title: World Bank sanctions eCitizen director James Ayugi and his company

title: She Made it - the Youngest South African Woman to Swim the Channel
desc: DOVER, England, Aug. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Supported by the CMO Council and other boosters, 18-year-old Amber-Rose Berry of Pringle Bay, near Cape Town, has made history as the youngest-ever South African woman to swim the iconic English Channel.
